autoframeskip.description: Enable or disable auto frame skipping / limiting.

bios.description: Path to the Saturn BIOS image file.

cdrom.description: Path to the CDROM device file.

iso.description: Path to a Saturn game dump file (ISO or bin/cue).

no_bios.description: Use the emulated bios instead of a file.

autoload_slot.description: Savestate slot to autoload when starting.

binary.description: Path to a binary file for homebrew testing (optionally :address).
